app.name: PDF to Code
app.tagline: Turn a PDF into HTML or React you can actually edit

login.title: Enter your access code
login.subtitle: This tool is in private development. It is not open to the public yet.
login.codePlaceholder: Enter the code you were given
login.notAPassword: This is a shared access code, not a personal password. Do not enter a password you use anywhere else.
login.accountSubtitle: Sign in to your account, or create one.
login.accountsUnavailable: Accounts are not configured on this deployment. Set the Firebase variables in .env.local.
login.resetSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.
login.errorBadCredentials: That email and password do not match an account.
login.errorBadEmail: That is not a valid email address.
login.errorEmailTaken: An account already exists for that email. Sign in instead.
login.errorWeakPassword: That password is too weak. Use a longer one.
login.errorTooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.errorNetwork: Could not reach the sign-in service. Check your connection.
login.errorProviderOff: That sign-in method is not enabled for this project.
login.errorUnauthorizedDomain: This domain is not registered with Firebase, so Google sign-in is blocked here. Email and password still work.
login.devSignInNote: Local development only — this button does not exist in a production build.

overview.title: Overview
overview.emptyBody: Activity is kept in this browser tab only and disappears when you refresh. Your files never leave your computer.

convert.title: Convert
convert.chooseFile: Choose a PDF or PowerPoint file
convert.dragHint: or drag one anywhere on this page
convert.keepGraphicsOn: Vector art and images are preserved as a background layer. Larger file, looks identical to the PDF.
convert.keepGraphicsOff: Text only — clean, editable markup, but any graphics from the original are dropped.
convert.pptxUnavailable: PowerPoint conversion is not available here. Export “{name}” as a PDF and convert that.
convert.converted: Converted {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
convert.scannedBody: It has no text layer, so the output will keep the page images but the text will not be selectable or searchable.
convert.tooLongBody: Only the first {limit} will be converted.
convert.uploadedTitle: This presentation was converted on our server.
convert.uploadedBody: PowerPoint has no browser converter, so the file was sent to us, turned into a PDF and deleted immediately — nothing was stored. Everything from here on happens in your browser, as it does for a PDF.

preview.outputHint: The converted page on its own
preview.truncated: Showing the first {shown}k characters of {total}k. The download contains the whole file.
preview.renderFailed: Could not render the original page.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Kept in this tab only. Refreshing clears it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: The interface language. Your documents are converted in whatever language they are written in.
settings.defaultsHint: Pre-selected the next time you convert something.
settings.storageHint: Nothing is stored on our servers — no files, no accounts, no history. Preferences live in this browser only.

warnings.SCANNED: This PDF has no text layer — it is a scan. The output keeps the page images, but the text will not be selectable or searchable without OCR.
warnings.GRAPHICS_DROPPED: {count, plural, one {# page contains} other {# pages contain}} graphics that text-only output cannot reproduce. Turn on “Keep graphics” to keep them.
warnings.TRUNCATED: Only the first {limit} of {total} pages were converted.
warnings.NO_OFFSCREEN_CANVAS: This browser cannot render page backgrounds, so the output is text-only. Try Chrome, Edge or a recent Firefox for full visual fidelity.
